title: Source files
responsibility: Lets a person read source files from the displayed entity and revision, only on the Source tab.

inputs.name: DetailsPanel.entity
inputs.description: Entity supplying its kind, size and performance text, owned source paths and identifier. A source request is scoped to this identifier. An empty source list produces “No source files recorded.”

inputs.name: DetailsPanel.workspace
inputs.description: Workspace supplying the source-reading bridge, snapshot revision commit and project context. These are required when a source is selected. Failures during that request, including unavailable required context, are caught and shown as text.

outputs.name: DetailsPanel
outputs.description: Source files for the displayed entity and revision. Choosing a file clears old text and errors, requests its contents and shows the result. A failed read displays an alert.
